brief: Clear any encroaching vegetation or obstructions to maintain unobstructed airflow to the radiator banks and ventilation openings, giving clearance work precedence over other remedial activity as specified in SOP-011 and SOP-015. Inspect all intake and exhaust louvres for blockage by debris, and record every de-rating applied along with its reason, value, and period in accordance with MG-021. Restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified, not when the event ends, per MG-021.
